about: Every module of the dashboard's browser code that writes the browser's storage, the slots it writes, and whose each
is. every-slot-says-whose-it-is.test.mjs finds the writers in the syntax tree (a call of `setItem`) and fails on one
with no row here, and on a row for a module that writes none. A new slot takes a row in the change that adds it.
in      "tab": the tab's session, gone with the tab. "device": the browser's local storage, there on the next visit.
device     this device's own: a choice, a clock mark of a window it opened. Nothing of a workspace's records.
tab        this tab's own mark for its session. Nothing of a workspace's records.
keyed      one workspace's, kept under the workspace's own slug or id, and never read under another's.
by record  one workspace's, kept under a record's own id and only read by that id.
cleared    one workspace's rows or a member's words, removed by the bridge as the tab leaves the workspace or the
person leaves the tab: a switch, a sign-out, a session that ended (bridge/surface-cache.ts sealSurfaceCache).
Its `slot` is the name itself, or its head where a name carries on after it; the test fills each and runs

app/(os)/error.tsx.slot: the report kept for after the reload
app/(os)/error.tsx.what: The error this page load caught (its id, its name, its first line, the page), for the report sheet after the reload that heals it.
When the page last reloaded for a chunk that would not load, so it does so once.

src/auth/preview-claim.ts.what: A preview's claim, while its visitor signs in with Google; fifteen minutes.

src/bridge/api.ts.what: That the tab went home once for a read the server could place in no workspace, so it does not loop.

src/bridge/ask/notices.ts.what: When AI was last opened on this device.

src/bridge/ask/palette.ts.what: The language AI was last asked in.

src/bridge/ask/voice.ts.what: The voice session this tab has open, so a second one is not begun.

src/bridge/device-prefs.ts.what: The theme and the look chosen on this device.

src/bridge/invitations/accept.ts.what: The words for the workspace this sign-in just joined, said once after the load that follows the accept. It must outlive that load, which seals the cache, so the clear leaves it.

src/bridge/notifications.ts.slot: the bell's read state, by workspace id
src/bridge/notifications.ts.what: Which notices this device has read and when it last looked, under the workspace's id.

src/bridge/read-cache.ts.what: The reads a page kept in the tab (a person's page, the log), each under the workspace it was asked in.

src/bridge/surface-cache.ts.what: Each surface's last rows, one slot a workspace, drawn before the first read on the next load.

src/bridge/tab-memory.ts.what: Where the member was in each view of a page, under the workspace.
Work half-done (a reply, a Find), under the workspace.

src/bridge/workspace.ts.what: The slug of the last workspace used, where the home sends a returning tab. A request, never a grant: the server decides.

src/bridge/zone.ts.what: Each workspace's time zone as last read, under its slug, for the first paint's clock.

src/surfaces/campaigns/ads/connect/use-a.what: When Meta's connect window was opened from this device; an hour.

src/surfaces/campaigns/content/list.tsx.what: The columns and order chosen for Content's lists on this device.

src/surfaces/campaigns/content/views.tsx.what: Grid or List, as chosen on this device.

src/surfaces/campaigns/home/left-at.ts.what: The list and view of Content last shown on a phone: Made, the Library, Ads. Never a piece.

src/surfaces/campaigns/parts/whatsapp-li.what: When WhatsApp's own list was last asked for, with the workspace it was asked in.

src/surfaces/campaigns/reach-out/surface.what: The sequence the next pile on Leads adds to: its id and its name.

src/surfaces/files/footage/use-footage.t.what: When Google's folder window was opened from this device; fifteen minutes.

src/surfaces/files/video/send.ts.what: Where a clip's upload stood, to take it up after a reload: the file's id and its address, under the workspace it was going to and the clip's fingerprint; under four hours.

src/surfaces/frame/first-rows.ts.what: A phone's last screen of rows, one slot a workspace, for the next visit's first paint.

src/surfaces/inbox/carried-reply.ts.what: A reply carried to a thread from another page: the thread and the words.
The person Not a person was asked of, on the way to their page.
The thread AI's draft was asked for.

src/surfaces/kit/motion/keyboard.ts.what: How tall this phone's keyboard last stood.

src/surfaces/leads/last-order.ts.what: The order Leads was last asked in, a workspace at a time under a word made of its slug, never its name; twenty at most.

src/surfaces/people/hooks/view-store.ts.what: The columns, widths and order chosen for People's lists on this device.

src/surfaces/people/person/name-offer.ts.what: The members this device has told once how a person is named: their own ids.

src/surfaces/people/person/notices/fact-.what: The notices hidden on a person's page, under the person's id: ids alone.

src/surfaces/reports/surface.ts.what: The period Reports last showed on this device.

src/surfaces/settings/connections/whatsa.what: When this tab began WhatsApp's sign-up, so a mark left by a page that is gone is told from one running.

src/surfaces/setup/first-run/hooks.tsx.what: That this tab's session has landed on the first run once.

src/surfaces/setup/override.ts.what: The same mark, written where Setup's read sends the tab there.

src/surfaces/today/zones/setup-card-body.what: That Today's setup card was folded on this device.
